description: Agent Handoffs: submit a system’s task handoff records (each with its id, the task, who sent it, who received it, when, where the task stood when it moved, the constraints it travels under such as a deadline, budget or limit, and when the record was written) and optionally the task moves seen in other logs (a tracker, a queue or message logs). The signed report counts every handoff that keeps the essentials and names every record missing the task, its current state or who sent it (the core a handoff cannot be reconstructed without), every record missing the constraints, every record written more than an hour after the handoff, and every move seen elsewhere with no handoff record behind it, with the fix for each. This reads the records of handoffs a system made: one job’s state assembled into a resume pack is wever_job-handoff-pack, a signed sender-to-recipient pack is wever_agent-to-agent-handoff-pack, an operator handover package is wever_handover-check and the format every handoff uses is wever_context-transfer-check. Verdict handoffs_are_rumors, record_gaps, records_unverified or handoffs_recorded. POST /api/handoff-record-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-handoffs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-handoffs/.

constraints.description: The constraints it travels under, such as a deadline, a budget or a limit.

state.description: Where the task stood when it was handed over, such as draft quote ready, awaiting approval.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

observed.description: Task moves seen in other logs, such as a tracker, a queue or message logs, to find handoffs with no record.

name: wever_handoff-record-check
title: Handoff record check
